scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @yas-chat/api" "npm run dev -w @yas-chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @yas-chat/web && npm run build -w @yas-chat/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yas-chat/api && npm run typecheck -w @yas-chat/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @yas-chat/api && npm run test -w @yas-chat/web
